current_capture.kind: fresh connected UI captures on an isolated synthetic stack
current_capture.stack: isolated loopback stack with its own GoTrue, Redis, PostgreSQL database and MinIO bucket; synthetic @demo.test people; no other environment or data

browser.session: GoTrue password grant stored as the app token and runtime config injected (no login UI)
browser.network: requests outside the three stack origins aborted

current_capture.permission_changes: API only: the seed (GoTrue admin and Cloud REST, operator for the installation policy) and owner calls removing/restoring the HR group in the HR space; UI confirmations were opened and cancelled; nothing was saved from the UI

captures.shows: Permissions panel as the owner: "Owners and selected members" with Alex and the Super_Users group selected; Access to all spaces summary below
asserted_by_spec: policy card "Owners and selected members" is selected
Alex and Super_Users rows are listed
captures.does_not_prove: Does not prove that the selections can create spaces (see server_readback).

captures.shows: Confirmation shown when choosing "Owners only" (narrowing who can create spaces); cancelled
captures.does_not_prove: Does not prove what saving would do.

captures.shows: Access to all spaces summary (Users, Can view) with the Manage groups button
captures.does_not_prove: Read-only summary; does not show coverage applied to a space.

captures.shows: Permissions panel as a member (Sam): "You can't create spaces in this workspace.", policy cards unavailable, "Only workspace owners can change this."
captures.does_not_prove: Does not prove the server refuses Sam's create request.

captures.shows: People > Groups > HR > General with the Access to all spaces menu open (Off ticked, Can view, Can edit)
captures.does_not_prove: No change saved; the open menu covers part of the description.

captures.shows: "Give HR access to all spaces?" confirmation for Can edit; cancelled
captures.does_not_prove: Does not prove what saving would do.

captures.shows: Manage Space > Members (HR, Custom): Name | Access | Role, owner "Full access", Alex "Can edit · default" with the Access menu open, HR and Users groups with their own levels
asserted_by_spec: Alex and HR access controls present
menu shows the space default option
captures.does_not_prove: Does not prove that a chosen level saves.

captures.shows: Access column header tooltip with the one explanation of per-person access
Manage Space > Members (Product): Olivia's own row (Can view) menu ends with "You can also edit this space through the Product group."
captures.does_not_prove: Server reported Olivia's access as Can edit through a group; no change saved.

captures.shows: Manage Space > General (HR, Custom), scrolled to "Who can add pages to this space: Only space owners"
captures.does_not_prove: Below the fold at 1440x900 until scrolled; does not prove that members are refused.

captures.shows: Create space dialog opened by the owner from New page, name typed, Public selected
Workspace menu for Alex: Create workspace and Import workspace unavailable, tooltip "Your administrator hasn't allowed you to create workspaces."
captures.does_not_prove: Does not prove the server refuses a creation request.

captures.shows: "You're not in a workspace yet" for Jordan with the pending invitation to Demo, the denial reason, Check again and Sign out
Sam's open "Onboarding checklist" (HR) after the owner removed the HR group from the HR space via the API: "No access to this page"
captures.does_not_prove: Server change made through the API, not the UI.

captures.shows: The same tab after the owner restored the HR group's Can edit via the API: page content back without a reload
captures.does_not_prove: No edit was typed or saved.

captures.shows: Sign-out question from Settings > Account & App with "Also remove my data from this browser"
captures.does_not_prove: Nobody signed out; does not prove what is removed.

limits: Chromium only, 1440x900, English; no Desktop, login screen or mobile layout.
Synthetic data on a self-hosted build; Worker, search and AI services not running.
Permission changes through owner/operator API calls; saving from these controls is covered by component and server tests, not by this run.
Jordan's invitation is a guest invitation because the three member seats are taken.
